FIFA suspends his ban under Article 27 of the FIFA Disciplinary Code , placing it on a one-year probationary period while allowing the red card itself to stand. It became the first time since the introduction of FIFA's automatic suspension system that a World Cup red card suspension is overturned rather than served. (BBC News) ( The New York Times )

Norway advances to the quarterfinals of a FIFA World Cup for the first time after defeating Brazil 2–1 in the round of 16 . Brazil's loss also marks the team's earliest elimination from the tournament since 1990 . (AFP via RFI)

In association football , Spain records its sixth consecutive FIFA World Cup clean sheet in a 1–0 win over Portugal in the round of 16 , setting a tournament record , while goalkeeper 우나이 시몬 extends his scoreless streak to 609 minutes. (ANI)

In association football , Argentine forward and captain 리오넬 메시 becomes the first player to score in nine consecutive World Cup matches (including the previous edition ), after scoring in the team's 3–2 victory against Egypt in the round of 16 . (ABC News)
Switzerland advances to the quarterfinals of the FIFA World Cup for the first time since 1954 after beating Colombia in a penalty shootout in the round of 16. (CBS Sports)

Seventy-two lawmakers from the European Parliament call for an investigation into FIFA president Gianni Infantino after FIFA lifted the red-card suspension on American striker 폴러린 발로건 . ( Politico Europe )
In association football , Argentine forward and captain 리오넬 메시 becomes the first player to reach 10 assists in FIFA World Cup matches since records began in 1966. (ABC News) ( The Chosun Daily )

The quarterfinals end with the four highest-ranked teams in the FIFA Men's World Ranking ( Argentina , Spain , France , and England ) advancing to the semifinals , the first time this has happened since the rankings were introduced in 1992. (BBC Sport) (Fox Sports)
In association football , England beats France 6–4 in the highest-scoring third-place playoff in FIFA World Cup history, securing their best result since winning the tournament in 1966 . (BBC Sport)

French footballer 킬리안 음바페 scores twice to become the highest-scoring player in World Cup history , and the first player to score 10 goals in a single World Cup since Germany 's 게르트 뮐러 in 1970 . (BBC Sport)

After winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup, Spain becomes the first country to hold both the men's and women's World Cups , having won the latter in 2023 . The men's team extends their international football record of 38 consecutive unbeaten matches, surpassing Italy 's record of 37. It also becomes the first team to field two teenagers, 라민 야말 and 파우 쿠바르시 , both 19-year-olds, in a FIFA World Cup final. (NPR) (Reuters) (FOX Sports)

In association football , Spain win their second FIFA World Cup title after defeating the defending champions Argentina 1–0 after extra time in the final held at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford , New Jersey , United States. Spain's captain Rodri is awarded the Golden Ball . (France 24) (Yahoo! Sports)
Spanish manager Luis de la Fuente also becomes the oldest manager to win a World Cup title at 65 years old. (Reuters)
In association football , 첼시 sign attacking midfielder 모건 로저스 from 애스턴 빌라 for a British record transfer fee of £ 117 million. (BBC Sport)
In association football , Burkina Faso , Mali , and Niger submit joint bids to host the 2032 Africa Cup of Nations under the Alliance of Sahel States . (BBC Sport)

FIFA opens an investigation into the Argentina national football team over altercations during the World Cup final and the display of a banner of the Falklands . ( The Athletic via The New York Times )

In association football , UEFA announces that it will boycott the 2030 FIFA World Cup , scheduled to be hosted by current champions Spain along with Morocco and Portugal , if FIFA president Gianni Infantino proceeds with plans to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors. (Sky Sports)

Carlos Cordeiro , senior FIFA executive and adviser to FIFA president Gianni Infantino , resigns in protest of Infantino's plans to sell stakes in FIFA Forward Enterprise to private investors, including American banking institution JPMorgan Chase , calling them "a bad deal for FIFA's members, a bad deal for football , and a bad deal for the long-term future of the game". (Sky News)
The Asian Football Confederation joins UEFA in opposing Infantino's plans and vows to boycott the next tournament if they go ahead. ( The Independent )
Infantino reverses his plan to sell stakes in the FIFA World Cup amidst backlash. (ESPN)
